title: Introduce pseudo-ground-truth fusion for staged backfill and CI soft-fail policy
author: Maya Ortega
release_notes: Adds staged backfill pipeline with pseudo-ground-truth fusion and a CI soft-fail adapter that permits progressive rollout while flagging quality regressions.
description: Motivation: Large prompt-set backfills are expensive and risk noisy regressions when ground-truth labels are sparse. This PR adds a pseudo-ground-truth (pseudo-GT) fusion step that combines a small curated human label set with high-confidence model-derived annotations to create a richer reference for regression checks. It also introduces a staged backfill executor that runs in prioritized waves and a CI soft-fail policy so teams can detect degradations early without hard-blocking merges. Key design points: 1) Pseudo-GT fusion algorithm that weights human labels and model annotations by calibrated confidence; 2) Staged backfill orchestration with configurable wave sizes, sampling heuristics, and conservative promotion criteria; 3) CI soft-fail adapter that surfaces regression score deltas as a "soft-fail" status and integrates with the existing eval CI dashboard to track exposure and recovery; 4) runtime telemetry hooks to emit per-prompt scoring, cohort-level deltas, and fusion provenance to Redwood Console. Rollout plan: feature gated behind eval.feature.pseudo_gt (off by default); run canary backfills on 5k prompt subset then 50k then full set; enable soft-fail in CI for 2 weeks before considering hard enforcement. Checklist: - [x] Add pseudo-GT fusion module and unit tests; - [x] Add staged backfill executor and scheduling; - [x] Add CI adapter for soft-fail signaling; - [x] Add telemetry and Console wiring; - [x] Docs and runbook. See related items: ENG-1942 (fusion research), SUP-4812 (customer incident that motivated progressive recovery strategy).

reviews: Ethan Chu: Overall strong design. Suggested tightening the promotion criteria to require stable delta over 3 consecutive waves; author implemented and added test coverage.

Priya Nair: Asked for clarity on how fusion handles label conflicts; author replied with formula and added comment and unit tests demonstrating tiebreaker behavior (human labels take precedence when confidence delta < 0.05).
Lars Müller: Requested telemetry cardinality limit to protect metrics cost; author added sampling and cardinality bounds configurable via telemetry.max_unique_prompts.
